other_conditions: Must have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Worker’s membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application
Worker must be unmarried at the time of applying for the financial assistance
Worker should have at least a two‑month subscription
Benefit is provided for the marriage of up to two children of a registered married worker
Application must include a wage slip or appointment letter verifying 90 days of work, or a certificate from a local authority if those documents are unavailable
A one‑time registration fee is required, valid for three years, after which renewal with proof of 90 days work each year is necessary
Application should be submitted within any prescribed period
benefits_summary: Provides ₹51,000 for the marriage of a registered unmarried worker and ₹51,000 per child for up to two children of a married worker.
documents_required: wage slip or appointment letter from employer
certificate from local authority (councilor, executive officer, or Panchayat Secretary)
